correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: reflection group sends every nonzero normal into D4 closed simple-root chamber; 15 nonempty strict-wall patterns, mod S3 triality of outer nodes, give seven (b,k) strata. Dot products of all D4 roots have constant signs on each relatively open chamber face; this is the infinite-normal reduction. Independent exact rational combinatorics rebuilt 24 vertices, 96 edges, 24 octahedral facets, sliced all 15 strata including fully contained triangular faces, and confirmed all seven polygon histograms, Euler identities, and distinct face vectors. Thus neither finite sampling alone nor metric similarity is asserted.
